kind.value: Content discovery and scheduling with reusable post buckets, a smart queue and evergreen recycling

pricingModel.value: Plan tiers with account, user and queue limits; monthly and annual billing; extra capacity available

freeOption.value: Free: 1 account, 1 user, 30 queued posts and 12 daily posts/profile

trial.value: 7-day trial; accounts move to Free if no paid plan is chosen

entryPaid.value: Starter $14/month on monthly billing; $9/month billed annually ($108/year), 3 accounts and 1 user

plans.value: Monthly: Starter $14, Growth $59, Business $99, Agency $179. Annual monthly equivalents: $9, $39, $69, $119. Included account/user caps: 3/1, 15/2, 25/5, 50/10 respectively

networks.value: Facebook Pages, Instagram business/creator, Threads, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn profiles/pages, Pinterest, TikTok, X, YouTube and Bluesky
networks.note: X and Pinterest require Growth or higher.

api.value: Not listed in the checked product and pricing documentation

mcp.value: Not listed in the checked product and pricing documentation

ai.value: Unlimited AI hashtags, content and captions; AI images have plan-specific monthly limits

teams.value: 1 user on Free/Starter, 2 on Growth, 5 on Business and 10 on Agency; extra members are available. Approval workflow details are not listed in the checked plan documentation
